Three of them mention arbitration:

- **Acme_MSA.pdf**, §14.2
- **Brightline_SOW.docx**, §9
- **Northwind_NDA.pdf**, §11

Eight others have no mention of it. I couldn't check **Vendor_Agreement_2019.pdf** because it's a scanned image with no extractable text, so it may or may not have an arbitration clause. Running OCR on it or checking it by hand would settle it.
